tagline: The world's leading outdoor advertising company with digital transformation leadership
hero_kpi_rationale: Digital revenue (DOOH) now represents 36.8% of total revenue, up sharply (+4.1 pts), and is the primary driver of the group's transformation, fueled by the adoption of programmatic advertising and data.
company_description: JCDecaux SE operates as an outdoor advertising company worldwide. It operates through three segments: Street Furniture, Transport, and Billboard. The Street Furniture segment provides advertising services in shopping malls; rents street furniture; and sells and rents equipment, such as automatic public toilets, bikes, etc., as well as provides cleaning, maintenance, and other services. This segment also includes advertising in the public domain on bus shelters, free-standing information panels, kiosks, and multi-service columns. The Transport segment provides advertising services in public transport systems, including airports, metros, buses, trams, and trains. The Billboard segment is involved in advertising on private property, including traditional large format or back-light billboards; neon-light billboards; and advertising wall wraps. The company was founded in 1964 and is based in Neuilly-sur-Seine, France. JCDecaux SE is a subsidiary of JCDecaux Holding SAS.

kpis.name: Digital Revenue Mix
kpis.explanation: Proportion of revenue from digital screens (DOOH) in total revenue.
kpis.description: DOOH reached 36.8% of total revenue in H1 2024, up from 32.7% a year earlier, driven by the deployment of digital screens on premium locations.

kpis.name: Programmatic Advertising Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated via the VIOOH platform, based on real-time auctions powered by data.
kpis.description: Programmatic revenue increased by 61.8% to €59.7M, representing 9.0% of digital revenue, with 46 DSPs connected to VIOOH now active in 21 countries.

kpis.name: Organic Adjusted Revenue Growth
kpis.explanation: Revenue growth at constant scope and exchange rates.
kpis.description: Organic growth of +13.4% in H1 2024, peaking at +15.4% in Q2, driven by digital and sectors such as tech, media, and consumer goods.
kpis.signal: Positive organic growth across all segments and geographic regions

kpis.name: Adjusted Operating Margin
kpis.explanation: Adjusted operating margin as a percentage of revenue.
kpis.description: Adjusted operating margin reached €261.4M, or 14.5% of revenue (+1.8 pts vs 12.7% H1 2023), with improvements across all segments, particularly in Billboard.
kpis.signal: Profitability improvement driven by operating leverage

kpis.name: Adjusted Free Cash Flow
kpis.explanation: Company's ability to generate cash after investments.
kpis.description: Adjusted free cash flow amounted to -€20.1M in H1 2024, a significant improvement (+€159.6M vs -€179.7M H1 2023), supported by higher self-financing capacity of €138.9M.

kpis.name: Capital Expenditures
kpis.explanation: Investment in fixed assets, particularly for the deployment of digital screens.
kpis.description: Capex amounted to €159.0M in H1 2024, maintained at a high level to support the selective deployment strategy of digital screens on premium locations.
kpis.signal: Sustained capex to accelerate digitalization of premium sites

kpis.name: Total Assets
kpis.description: Total assets extracted from yfinance over the last four years.
kpis.signal: Total assets of €8.14B in the latest year

kpis.name: Total Debt
kpis.description: Total debt extracted from yfinance over the last four years.
kpis.signal: Total debt of €3.93B in the latest year

risks.title: Increased competition in digital out-of-home advertising
risks.summary: The growth of the DOOH market is attracting new players and platforms, increasing competitive pressure on JCDecaux, particularly through DSPs connected to VIOOH. The expansion of the programmatic ecosystem intensifies competition for advertising market share.
risks.score_rationale: The risk is implicitly mentioned in the strong growth of DOOH and VIOOH, with moderate language intensity but a clear trend toward competitive technological upgrading. The 'Competition' category weighs heavily in the fast-growing sector.

risks.title: Dependence on local outdoor advertising regulations
risks.summary: In France, billboard activity remains stable due to regulatory restrictions limiting physical expansion and analog-to-digital conversion, constraining growth despite demand.
risks.score_rationale: The document explicitly cites regulation as a constraint in France, with strong language ('rationalization in line with regulations'). The risk is stable but critical in mature markets.

risks.title: Cybersecurity of programmatic platforms
risks.summary: The growth of the VIOOH platform, connected to 46 DSPs across 21 countries, increases exposure to cyber threats related to advertising data management and programmatic campaign integrity.
risks.score_rationale: Although not directly mentioned, the rise of programmatic DOOH (VIOOH) and advertising data management exposes JCDecaux to cyber risks. Intensity is moderate, but the trend is upward with digital expansion.

risks.title: Sluggish recovery in China
risks.summary: Transport and Street Furniture in China suffer from a slow post-Covid recovery, affecting the Group's overall performance despite double-digit organic growth in the Asia-Pacific region.
risks.score_rationale: The text emphasizes that activity in China remains 'significantly below' pre-Covid levels, with strong language and central positioning in comments. The risk is persistent.

risks.title: Dependence on urban mobility contracts
risks.summary: JCDecaux heavily relies on long-term public contracts for the installation and operation of street furniture and advertising infrastructure in transport, exposing the company to contract renegotiations or losses.
risks.score_rationale: Street furniture and transport contracts are central to the business model. Language is factual but repeated, indicating a high structural risk with a stable trend.

risks.title: Risks from accelerated digitalization
risks.summary: Investment in digital screens, data, and programmatic capabilities, while growth-enabling, exposes JCDecaux to rapid technological obsolescence and high upgrade costs.
risks.score_rationale: Digital transformation is a growth driver (36.8% of digital revenue), but involves significant technology investments. Intensity is high, trend is upward.

risks.title: Concentration of location suppliers
risks.summary: JCDecaux depends on a limited number of public authorities and infrastructure managers for access to strategic locations, limiting flexibility and increasing the risk of contract disruption.
risks.score_rationale: Not explicitly mentioned, but implied in dependence on urban contracts. Risk is moderate, but reinforced by sector structure. Secondary position in the document.

risks.title: Reputation related to sustainability and climate commitments
risks.summary: Leadership in sustainable development is an asset, but any deviation from Net Zero commitments by 2050 or ESG standards could severely damage JCDecaux's reputation.
risks.score_rationale: The document highlights ESG rankings and SBTi validation, indicating strong reputational exposure to environmental performance. Language is positive, but underlying risk is high.

ai_positioning.summary: JCDecaux integrates artificial intelligence through its VIOOH programmatic platform, leveraging data to optimize advertising campaigns in real time. The company positions itself as a key player in the adoption of AI in digital out-of-home advertising.
evidence: +61.8% growth in programmatic revenue via VIOOH to €59.7M
VIOOH platform is the most connected in the industry with 46 DSPs linked, active in 21 countries
Displayce (partner DSP) platform active in 80 countries
Use of data for innovative, data-driven dynamic campaigns
